name: Industrial Automation and Communications Systems a Division of Triangle Electric, Inc.
old_description: Triangle Electric has been serving Western North Dakota and the Eastern Montana area since 1946, delivering exemplary customer service and industry excellence to help complete your electrical construction project.
about:
Triangle Electric, Inc. was founded in 1946 by Harold Hoffelt, Oscar Stenehjem, and Selmer Johnson as a family-owned electrical contractor in Minot, North Dakota. The company established a second location in Williston, ND, and has remained locally owned and operated since its inception.

In 2008, Triangle Electric launched its Industrial Automation & Communication Systems division, a design-build UL-listed panel shop that provides industrial automation services and safety-standards compliance. The division operates from both the Minot and Williston facilities, delivering custom control panels and automation solutions for regional projects.

The company serves customers across western North Dakota and eastern Montana, primarily in electrical construction and the energy sector. A noted client reference includes Schmidt Electric of Killdeer, ND, which was acquired by Tarpon Energy Services, illustrating the firm's involvement in oil-and-gas infrastructure.

Triangle Electric attributes its longevity to its workforce, stating that "our people make the difference," and emphasizes an unmatched depth of working knowledge in the automation field as a core differentiator.
